title.zh: 在南阿古桑省Prosperidad市镇设立Los Arcos国立中学并为此拨款的法案
title.en: An Act Providing for the Establishment of Los Arcos National High School in the Municipality of Prosperidad, Province of Agusan Del Sur, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.orig: An Act Providing for the Establishment of Los Arcos National High School in the Municipality of Prosperidad, Province of Agusan Del Sur, and Appropriating Funds Therefor
title.vi: Đạo luật thành lập Trường Trung học Los Arcos Quốc gia tại Thị trấn Prosperidad, Tỉnh Agusan Del Sur, và phân bổ kinh phí cho mục đích này
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติจัดตั้งโรงเรียนมัธยมศึกษา Los Arcos แห่งชาติในเทศบาล Prosperidad จังหวัด Agusan Del Sur และจัดสรรเงินทุนสำหรับการนี้
title.id: Undang-Undang membentuk Sekolah Menengah Los Arcos Nasional di Kotamadya Prosperidad, Provinsi Agusan Del Sur, dan mengalokasikan dana untuk itu
title.ms: Akta menubuhkan Sekolah Menengah Los Arcos Kebangsaan di Perbandaran Prosperidad, Wilayah Agusan Del Sur, dan memperuntukkan dana untuk itu

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 4 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra1998/ra_8447_1998.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: There shall be established in the Municipality of Prosperidad, Province of Agusan del Sur, Los Arcos National High School, under the control and supervision of the Department of Education, Culture and Sports.
This school shall be known officially as the Los Arcos National High School.
The amount necessary to carry out the provisions of this Act shall be included in the General Appropriations Act of the year following its enactment into law and thereafter.
This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
